reviews.name: Jason Kirwan
reviews.text: We used Wedding Day 2 to help continue our wedding celebrations and we honestly couldn’t recommend them highly enough. Alan began the evening with a solo acoustic performance and absolutely blew the place away. Tom then continued into the night with a dj set and the dance floor was absolutely rocking! The booking process was so seamless and Lee was an absolute pleasure to deal with. We can’t thank them enough and they helped create memories that we will cherish forever!

reviews.name: Dervla C
reviews.text: We gave them our date and location and they sent a few options for live music with the price. We chose Cathal, who set up early at the venue and introduced himself to the owners of the pub. We were really impressed by him, he was professional and had a silky smooth voice. He knew when to get the energy up, and when to play some chiller music. Highlight was taking a request for Choosin' Texas and he learnt it on the fly! So many of our guests complimented Cathal, it was just the right energy for a relaxed day 2.

reviews.name: Stephen morgan
reviews.text:
We booked Wedding Day 2 for their trad band and solo performer package for our wedding, with Conor as our solo performer.

The whole process was really easy from start to finish and the team were great to deal with. The trad band were brilliant and Conor was great too. Everyone loved the music and it really helped make the day special.

We’d definitely recommend Wedding Day 2 to anyone looking for music for their wedding!

reviews.name: Jane Murphy
reviews.text:
We went with Wedding Day 2 for our wedding in Ballykealey House and had Lee playing for us. He was brilliant and everyone loved the music.

The whole process was very easy and straightforward, which was exactly what we needed. We didn’t have to worry about a thing and everything went perfectly on the day. Thanks guys!

reviews.name: Emma Rose Bargetto
reviews.text: Lee was FABULOUS for our rehearsal dinner. People couldn’t stop dancing. Incredible voice. Incredible crowd work. Was able to read the room and adapt accordingly. 100/10 would recommend booking.

reviews.name: Georgina Holland rome
reviews.text: Great to deal with! Very fast replies and efficient booking !
